identity: Post hoc mechanistic follow-up to an already evaluated fixed cross-guide probe; no new method, blind confirmation, or unseen-guide claim
fixed_objects: query pools, K=10 and tie rules
questions: Do guide-associated response differences recur across disjoint retained-cell halves?
Do shallow zero-weight entries show positive shared signal in retained cells?
Which fixed candidates account for existing score changes?
reference_data: Existing archived role=1 cells, disjoint from original role=0 input; same two guides, same screen; retain actual counts
primary_population: Two original input guides and at least four retained cells for each same guide. Other entries remain in tables and original ranking with unavailable diagnostics missing.

split.rule: Within target and guide, process sorted lanes. Within lane sort cell IDs by SHA256(seed|source|target|guide|lane|repeat|cell_id). Assign successive cells to whichever A/B half currently has fewer cells, breaking ties with A. Each lane and guide have half sizes differing by at most one; retain all cells.
split.interpretation: Repeat 0 primary; 20 deterministic repartitions describe split sensitivity, not independent replicates or confidence intervals.

quantities.C: (y1A^T M y2B + y1B^T M y2A)/(2G) - nu_c
quantities.C_full: full retained guide means cross-product/G - nu_c
quantities.C_half_A_B: within-half cross-guide mean products/G - nu_c, separately
quantities.D_input_ref: shallow guide-mean difference dot full retained guide-mean difference / G; same lexicographic guide ordering
quantities.metric_decomposition: Compute I, P=U U^T, M=I-0.9P using fixed controls; nu_c=tr(M V_control)/G. Plug-in estimates, no unconditional unbiasedness claim.
quantities.noise_correction: Signed values, never clip diagnostics. Shared-control covariance trace deducted from E/C. No zero imputation for unavailable groups.
quantities.imbalance_decomposition: lambda1=n1(n1-1)/(20*19), lambda2=n2(n2-1)/(20*19), lambdac=2*n1*n2/(20*19) using shallow counts. Sref=lambda1*E1+lambda2*E2+lambdac*C. Sref-C=(lambda1+lambda2)*D/2+(lambda1-lambda2)*(E1-E2)/2. Exact algebra, no causal interpretation.

primary: old crossguide_wM exactly zero among original two-guide entries
old crossguide_wM positive among original two-guide entries

summary: Per-source and pooled descriptive counts, medians, signed correlations, D>0 and C>0 counts, both-half C>0 counts, all 20 repartition positive fractions. Signs are not target-level significance tests. No pooled donor-population CI.
nomination_accounting: For fixed crossguide_wM minus original_wM memberships, query-direction-target contribution=delta_membership*reference_membership/(2*Q*10). Sum by target and original query block; positive and negative contributions and top-5 shares reported separately. Added and displaced support, exact tie fractions, full candidate pool, both references. No new candidate selection or reranking.
stop: One fixed diagnostic and accounting; verify identities and package all outcomes. No new weights, new list scores, parameter search, favorable-source selection, or new data collection.
resources: Local archived data only; compact sufficient statistics, no training. Stop recovery if matching fails; retain missingness. Aim incremental package below 10 MB; no raw matrices.
